verdict.rationale: Lovable's authentication docs say that asking it to add login generates the signup and login pages, wires them to the backend and applies row level security. Sign-in methods include email, phone, Google, Apple, Microsoft and SAML SSO, all in the built-in Cloud backend. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the scaffolded email/social auth flows work end to end.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder

citations.quote: Ask Lovable to add login, and it generates the signup and login pages, wires them to your backend, and protects user data with row level security.
Manage your app's users and configure how they sign in: email, phone, Google, Apple, Microsoft, and SAML SSO, all part of the built-in backend (Cloud).
Lovable hosts your app and includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required.
